drafts.subject: Mother's Day weekend at The Quarry — live music, new drinks & more
drafts.htmlBody:
THE QUARRY
Drinks  ·  Bites  ·  Live Music  ·  Golf

Your Weekend Starts Friday

From live music on the patio to a Mother's Day Garden Party, this weekend at The Quarry is one you don't want to miss. Highs in the 70s all three days — the patio will be open and the drinks will be cold.

LIVE MUSIC THIS WEEKEND

FRI · MAY 8
Scott & Liz
7 PM – 10 PM · No cover
SAT · MAY 9
Scott Logan
1 PM – 4 PM · No cover
SAT · MAY 9
BP Duo
7 PM – 10 PM · No cover
SUN · MAY 10
Mother's Day Garden Party
1 PM – 4 PM · No cover

Live music at The Quarry is always free — no cover, no tickets, no fuss. Just show up and enjoy. See the full band schedule.

HAPPY MOTHER'S DAY

Sunday, May 10 — bring Mom out for the Garden Party. Good food, great wine, live music, and a view she'll actually want to sit with for a while. We'd love to help you make it a morning she remembers.

NEW THIS WEEK — TWISTED DRINKS MENU

We've added two new drink categories to the menu, and they're worth exploring.

Twisted Barrel Sodas

  • Pink Rose — Sour Gummy flavor with Sprite
  • Cloudy with a Chance... — Sour Gummy, sweet cream, and Sprite
  • Quarry Float — Classic Root Beer float
  • Royal Flush — Blackberry syrup, Blue Raspberry syrup, and Red Bull (Regular or Sugar-Free)
  • Straight Royal Flush — Royal Flush with added cream

Twisted Buzzed Cocktails

  • Peach Berry Fizz — Vodka, cranberry, Peach Red Bull, splash of club soda
  • Coconut Cupcake — Rum Haven, vanilla vodka, sweet cream, Peach Red Bull
  • Bourbon Peach Tea — Bourbon, iced tea, and Peach Red Bull
  • Berry Bliss — Gin, blackberry syrup, cranberry, and Red Bull (Regular or Sugar-Free)
  • Pink Mermaid — Rum Haven, sweet cream, and Watermelon Red Bull

70s · 80s · 90s BINGO — REGISTER NOW

Throwback bingo is coming and spots fill fast. Grab your seat before it's gone — this one always sells out. Register for 70s 80s 90s Bingo here.

WINE CLUB — MAY 21 WITH AUGUSTA WINERY

Our next Wine Club night is Wednesday, May 21, featuring Augusta Winery. Membership includes food and drink for two — a full evening of guided pours and great company. Join the Wine Club or learn more here.

TEACHER APPRECIATION — MAY 24 THROUGH MAY 31

Show your school ID and enjoy a week of deals built just for the people who earned it most.

  • $5 — "Treat Yo' Self" Round · $5 off your next visit to The Quarry
  • $4 — Four Favorites · House wine & domestic bottles (Bud, Bud Light, Mich Ultra, Miller, Busch, Busch Light)
  • $3 — Three Cheers for Teachers · All draft beers
  • $2 — Partner Up · $2 off any pizza or pretzel

Valid May 24–31 with a valid school ID. No limit on good times.

HOLE-IN-ONE GOLF

Reserve a bay and take a swing. Each reservation is $30 for 50 minutes and includes 75 balls — a great way to warm up before dinner or make a full afternoon of it. Reserve your golf bay here.

See you this weekend,
The Quarry

drafts.htmlBody:
THE QUARRY

Drinks · Bites · Live Music · Golf

This week at The Quarry

April 29 - May 4, 2026

It is a full slate this week - local artists at the lake, live music three nights running, line dancing and bourbon Saturday, and a sunrise yoga session that ends with brunch and a glass of wine.

New Melle "Paint Out" Show & Sale

Thursday, April 30 - 5:00 PM

The Augusta Plein Air painters spend the day painting New Melle, then bring their finished work to The Quarry. Come down to see what they captured, and if a piece moves you, take it home. Judging starts at 5:30 PM, so arrive early.

Boots and Bourbon

Saturday, May 2 - Doors 5:30 PM

DJ kicks off at 6:00 with dance lessons. Social dancing starts at 7:00. Bring your boots.

21+ · $5 cover · No reservations needed

Un-Wine-D & Align - Yoga with Charity

Saturday, May 2 - 9:00-10:00 AM

Stretch, sip, and soak in the vineyard vibes. A relaxing yoga session surrounded by The Quarry, with a glass of wine, mimosa, or bloody mary after class, plus 10% off the brunch menu (included with your ticket). Beginners and seasoned yogis welcome.

To reserve: yogawithcharity@gmail.com

Live Music This Weekend

Friday, May 1 · 7-10 PMJanet Martin
Saturday, May 2 · 1-4 PMDave Caputo
Sunday, May 3 · 1-4 PMMixology

See you at The Quarry.

The Quarry

drafts.htmlBody:
Thursday, Oct 15, 6–9 PM. Six wines, food pairings, and 10% off bottles that night.
THE QUARRY
Rock & Vine Wine Club
Thursday, October 15

An Evening with
Trademark Winery

 
Our October tasting is next Thursday. Trademark is a wholesale distributor and fine wine resource that brings boutique and acclaimed producers from around the world to the region, and they’re pouring six of them for us, each with a food pairing from our kitchen.
When: Thursday, October 15, 6–9 PM
Where: The Quarry, 3960 Highway Z, New Melle, MO
Hosted by: Trademark Winery
Bottles: 10% off any bottle you take home that night
On the Pour List
2024 Fabrice Larochette Mâcon-Fuissé Chardonnay
2024 Lemelson Dry Riesling
2023 Cultivar Pinot Noir
2022 Les Vins Julien Côtes du Rhône Rouge
2022 Crossfork Creek Cabernet Sauvignon
2024 Miau Miau Malbec
Rock & Vine members: your seat and one guest are included. Just RSVP with the email on your membership so we have you on the list.
RSVP as a Member
Not a member? One $44.99 ticket covers you and a guest: the full tasting, a food pairing with every wine, and the bottle discount. We’re capping it at 15 tickets so the night stays relaxed.
Get Tickets for Two · $44.99
Want to come every month? Join Rock & Vine for $29.99/mo and your guest is always included.
See you Thursday,
The Quarry Wine Team
Questions? Reply to this email or call (636) 224-8257

THE QUARRY
New Melle, Missouri
Today · Sunday, October 11 · 11 AM–3 PM

Fall into Books

An all-ages bookish market at The Quarry
The tents are up and it’s happening today, 11 AM to 3 PM. Local authors, bookish vendors, a community book swap and plenty for the kids, plus food, drinks and live music on the turf. Come for the books, stay for the people.
